verdict.rationale: The Ohio Secretary of State is a state government business-filing and records authority. Its filings are state records held within Ohio's jurisdiction, so a user choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no such capability that would make the axis apply; the OHID security-standards claim concerns protection, not user-selectable residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
